title: Mode-realigned pointwise interpolation (MRPWI) for efficient POD-Galerkin parametric reduced-order models
summary: As a cornerstone of reduced-order modeling, the POD-Galerkin framework has garnered widespread attention and remains one of the most widely adopted approaches. Constructing POD-Galerkin PROMs involves integrating this framework with advanced interpolation techniques to obtain POD modes at target (unseen) parameters. While Grassmann manifold interpolation (GMI) serves as an accurate baseline, mode-realigned pointwise interpolation (MRPWI) is proposed to develop highly efficient PROMs that maintain comparable accuracy.
